reviews.text: Restaurant  was on  the second floor, we were asked  if we wanted  to sit outside  twice , temperature  was 100 degrees.  We ordered  a chicken  club , it took 30 minutes  to get to the table , the sandwich  was ok guacamole  paste not fresh avocado they dod not re fill our drinks
reviews.author: Anthony K.

reviews.text: Beautiful setting, diverse items on menu, and Matt's service is wonderful! He went above and beyond to ensure an exceptional experience.  Shame to know he's moving on but so glad I got to visit while he was serving. The blue cheese stuffed olives are delicious, the grapefruit juice so fresh, and the chocolate milk delicious! Yup, I said it. Chocolate milk. I tasted a few truffle fries as well and they were fabulous, starchy, and a hint of truffle oil. I hear the duck oil fries are also delicious. Didn't get a chance to try those. The servers were working very hard. Chara had the loveliest smile and warmth, and I loved witnessing management Brayam going out if his way to thank his team for all that they do.
reviews.author: Elicia N.

reviews.text:
What a fabulous time we had here, and Arba made it so!
We had a burger for lunch & it was DELISH! 
Arba let us know about the dueling piano, so we came back on Saturday and had a blast! 
She made the BEST espresso martini's & the boosie vanilla shake was a show stopper! 
Great vibe!
reviews.author: Lizabeth F.

reviews.text: A fun and casual place with great service. We enjoyed the dueling pianos with our visit to the pub.
reviews.author: Suzanne B.

reviews.text:
Seems like a really cool tavern located on campus with a fun 19th hole vibe. The bar is great and the indoor seating feels cozy and inviting.

My issue is a bit specific, but worth mentioning. I ordered the French dip and the first half was great. When I got to the second half, there was still paper stuck to the cheese that had been cooked into the sandwich. I probably should have spoken up and declined them remaking, but when they remade it, they only brought back half and it was not taken off the bill.

It ended up being a slightly awkward exchange with the waiter, who was otherwise very nice. Given the situation, it would have been a nice gesture to comp it.

That said, we will definitely be back at the hotel, and I would be open to giving this spot another try.

(The picture of my food was pre-paper discovery)
reviews.author: Sean S.

reviews.text: Bartender wasn't friendly and barely spoke. The servers looked unhappy and not engaging. The music was very energetic but with no known bands. When I asked for a glass of a certain wine I asked how long was the bottle open. She said not long and poured it without a so much as a "try it and if you don't like it, I'll open a new bottle" my wife ordered a Cosmo and asked what she used with the vodka. She answered knowingly but not with a smile. It came and my wife asked for a touch of simple syrup to sweeten it. The bartender somewhat reluctantly got it and poured in a bit. My wife stirred it and asked for a bit more, and after a bit more and another taste, my wife thanked her and she turned and stored the syrup. We got the feeling that everyone was just putting in their time. We would not consider this establishment for food or drinks. It's probably okay for thirsty golfers since it's above the pro shop and next to the 18th green.
reviews.author: Dave D.

reviews.text:
I stopped in here after a beautiful 18 holes of golf. The weather was so nice as it snowed in Ohio and was happy to be here in Arizona.
I did not want to rush back to Cave creek so I ordered a drink-Vodka and Soda /lime wedge.
The great lady at the bar was amazing, Brittany G. Was exactly what I needed. 
As she served my drink she remembered my name. This seems like a little thing but as golfers came in and sat down she welcomed all of them by name! What a pro!!
I ordered the sliders beef burgers with some sort of salad greens. When they arrived I jumped in on the greens and the taste were unbelievable!
The sliders were excellent. I ordered another drink and she knew it exactly.
The manger Brayum O.  Came and asked me how was everything. I said great!  He asked where I was from and I said Cleveland Ohio. We engaged in some sports conversation and he was so nice and sincere. 
My experience here was special for sure. These people represented the Phoenician with exceptional professionalism.
I will be back!!
reviews.author: Ted B.

reviews.text: A lively place to dine, catch a game, or listen to the dueling pianos with a perfect view of the mountains and golf course. The service was amazing and the food was plentiful and tasty. The highlight of the menu, it was the shake!!
reviews.author: Kiki C.

reviews.text:
We went with a party of 6 at 5:15 pm for an early dinner on a Thursday.  

We ordered 3 appetizers, chips and salsa, chicken wings, and blistered shishito peppers.  They were brought out at different times with no plates.  We asked for plates --and waited.  Waited some more. 

Eventually, shortly before our entrees arrived --we were brought plates. 

We waited for our dishes to be cleared when entrees arrived --which were brought out at 3 different times.  One of which was 5 minutes later than the rest of the table --fish and chips. 

The food was ok but the service was incredibly inattentive and slow.  

Cannot recommend.
reviews.author: Rob M.

reviews.text: Tonight I came for 25$ meal deal until September 2nd. I order two cowboy burgers and two margaritas. The deal through September 2nd includes one drink. One burger and one side for 25$ each. When I revveived my check my total was $70.92. I asked the server why it was so much more and she said it can't be combined with happy hour. And I said I didn't order off of happy hour I ordered off of the 25$ meal. She refused to change the total and still charged me $70.92. Although the burger was excellent this is poor service and false advertising. The servers name was Arba. I overheard heard talking to another person and it sounds like she is one of the main servers at the bar. This is not okay!!
reviews.author: Reagan W.

reviews.text: Burgers were pretty good! We ordered the burgers for the culinary countdown and we had already gotten a drink and the server didn't want to give us the one included with the meal. Pretty off putting experience
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text:
We dropped by for lunch and had a wonderful time. The restaurant has great views of the golf course. There's some outdoor seating if the weather is nice. 

We were seated right away as it was early and a weekday. Our server was friendly and attentive. 

We got the artichoke spinach dip and omg was it delicious. So cheesy and flavorful and perfect on top of the grilled bread. 

I got the black bean veggie burger with added cheese and loved it. The burger patty was large and a bit messy but full of flavors. Tator tots were crispy and a generous portion. 

They have a summer special with a burger, drink (house marg or soda) and a side (tots or a house side salad) for $25 with is a great deal!
reviews.author: Mansi S.

reviews.text:
If you're looking for an amazing meal with top-notch service and stunning golf course views, The Phoenician Tavern is it!

We were lucky to have Cody as our server--he was not only friendly and attentive but incredibly knowledgeable about celiac disease and gluten-free options, which made the experience stress-free and so enjoyable.

The burgers here are seriously TO DIE FOR--juicy, flavorful, and made just right. But the real showstopper was the gluten-free Waygu pastrami sandwich. I'm still thinking about it and honestly wanted to come back the next day just for that.

If you're gluten-free or just a fan of great food and service, don't miss this spot. Can't wait to return!
reviews.author: Brittney C.

reviews.text: Amazing space, great service, lovely food, beautiful and relaxing ambiance. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Ayo' A.

reviews.text: The Phoenician Tavern it's a cool spot to hang out for happy hour. The view from the patio of a massive golf course is beautiful. The happy hour menu offered nice bites and several drinks. I enjoyed this espresso martini as the presentation was everything and the taste was just right parking for this establishment is a little bit tricky. However, there is a large parking area around the corner from the restaurant and Tavern, we greet it right away upon arrival and was given the option. I'll be there seating inside or outside both options. Offered a great view and great ambience. Our waitress was friendly and checked on us quite often and made sure that our happy hour delights or our pleasing. The chicken nachos were a bit to be desired. I will suggest using a different type of cheese and larger portions of the chicken. If you're in the area try them out.
reviews.author: Camille R.

reviews.text: This is a nice happy hour spot. The atmosphere was nice. The service was good. The food was horrendous and the drinks were basic overall you're going for the location, but there are plenty of restaurants in Phoenix, Arizona. The vibe is upscale. There is plenty of parking. It is clean and welcoming. Hope you enjoy.
reviews.author: Tiffany H.

reviews.text: I went with 3 friends for dinner and we ate out on the patio. While the burger was One of the best burgers I've  ever had and we all enjoyed our meals and the drinks were delicious. When we realized they had live piano music at 8, we decided to move inside and enjoy it. Everything was great, the atmosphere, the service, the music. The only thing I was not happy about was when I decided to ask the server if they could make me a Mezcal old-fashioned. He said no problem. And brought me a delicious Mezcal old-fashioned. The problem occurred when we got the bill. There are five different price levels of Mezcal, which I didn't know. I was not asked which one I wanted, but they gave me the $35 one. So the drinks were actually $40 each and I had two. I was not happy about paying $80 for two drinks especially because I didn't know that was going to be the case. When my friend ordered a margarita she was asked what kind of tequila she wanted. I was not given the option.
reviews.author: Suzanne K.

reviews.text:
I was here about a year ago and remembered how good the salad was. I was back again this year and ordered the salad again. It was just as good! I can't rave enough on how tasty & fresh it was. The portion size is pretty big and it definitely filled me up...and then some! The fries are to die for as well. I've gotten their truffle fries and regular fries and they're all good. The size and crisp is just perfect. Just talking about it is making me crave it. 
   The first time I went, I dined in. They are located at the Phoenician a the golf house. The Tavern is right above the golf store. You can sit at a table overlooking the golf course or in the room with TVs to catch your game. They do have a bar there as well. The service has always been great. The second time I ordered from them, I called for pick up to eat in the room as I had work to do. The takeout was just as good! The fries were NOT soggy and stayed crisp for a long time. I'm a slow eater so thumbs up to the fries. 
    I haven't tried anything else because I'm always craving for their salads and fries! I highly recommend!
reviews.author: Patsy L.

reviews.text:
We came here for dinner our first night in town. I had tried to make a reservation before we got here, but I couldn't find anywhere to do so. Apparently they do take reservations, but not when I was trying to!
We opted to sit at the bar as a number of people were waiting for tables. It was really busy!
The servers at the bar were fine. I made the mistake of ordering an adult milkshake and it took quite a while to get it. It was an okay shake and may, or may not, have had liquor in it. It was the least boozy shake I've ever had - if it was supposed to be boozy, that is.
I ordered a burger and tots. It was very average. My husband got Nashville hot chicken bites and a beet salad. There was no flavor - or heat - in the chicken bites. There were about few inches of lettuce on top of the beets that my husband had to remove to find the beets. He said he has had far better beet salads. 
We're here for a week, but probably won't go back there.
reviews.author: Melanie B.

reviews.text:
Elevated pub food at its best. We are staying at the hotel so have been here a few times. The menu is pretty big. We have enjoyed everything we had. My favorite is the AZ Cobb. It is delicious. Their tater tots are also pretty addicting. 

Nice location over looking the golf course. Nice indoor-outdoor flow and seating. 

The service has been top notch. Each server has been very friendly and attentive.
reviews.author: Emma T.

reviews.text: Great pub grub.  Wagyu Reuben is really good.  AZ Cobb salad is huge with chicken or salmon.  Wagyu sliders are great.
reviews.author: Jason H.

reviews.text:
The Phoenician Tavern, by the green,
The menu's heavy, if you know what I mean.
But we split a salad, some chicken bites too,
Bruschetta so good, we gave it its due.
Light options scarce, but we made do,
Dishing out four stars for the bites we threw.
reviews.author: Rhyme And D.

reviews.text: The food, service, and ambiance is top notch.  Eat here before or after your round of golf on the beautiful Phoenician Golf Course.
reviews.author: Mike S.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing, the best food I've had in a very long time. Service is absolutely amazing as well! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Nolan K.

reviews.text: The food here is delicious! We had breakfast here twice and ordered "late night" room service while staying at the Phoenician. Idk if it's because Cotton + Mowry is closed and their staff is here or if this is how it usually tastes... but everything tasted top notch. Highly recommend it. If you are platinum or higher with Marriott, you can eat continental breakfast or order regular items and credit $37.50 towards your breakfast bill with the voucher.
reviews.author: karla v.

reviews.text: The Phoenician tavern was delicious. We went for restaurant week and were surprised at the amount and quality of the food. Our waiter Patrick was super friendly and made the experience that much better.
reviews.author: Schuyler D.

reviews.text: Food was truly excellent pub fare, ambience was charmingly apres golf with lots of TV's and, service was fine.  Good little resort spot.
reviews.author: Brian M.

reviews.text: Nice patio and a warm welcome. Nice servers and decent prices but the food isn't great. Shrimp cocktail was okay. Liked the spinach & artichoke dip & the Kobe sliders. Definitely did not like the very greasy and over battered fish & chips. Tasted like they were all fried together and SO greasy! Also no coleslaw to balance out anything. Glad we tried it but won't be back. FYI they have the same greasy fries at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.author: Janet B.

reviews.text: Staying at the hotel so tried it out. Food was ok. Typical of hotel food. Nothing to write about. If you're here it'll work.
reviews.author: Nicole J.

reviews.text:
It's a Tavern but at the Phoenician.

Pretty standard tavern menu, we had chicken club and French dip,  well done but what stand out is the service and smile/attitude of the staff!.

Was a wonderful Christmas Day experience
reviews.author: Charles C.

reviews.text: This burger was massive. I know it's tough to cook a thick one like this so it was a little well but still had great flavor. I was full for the rest of the day. Service was oddly slow for how empty they were mid afternoon. Nice views on the patio if you sit out there.
reviews.author: Chris W.

reviews.text: Great food, fun atmosphere, and Daniel, the bartender was amazing.  He was personable and made us amazing drinks!
reviews.author: Jackie N.

reviews.text: Enjoyed lunch here after a round of golf! Everything we had was delicious and the service was prompt.  Highly recommend the pretzel bits with cheese!
reviews.author: Captain C.

reviews.text: I was disappointed, went here with my boyfriend for our anniversary and it started off with slow service which isn't usually a big deal to me if I'm not in the rush. Pretzel appetizer was decent enough. Then meal time came and my shrimp stuffed rigatoni wasn't even cooked  the noodles were still a bit hard and the shrimp was rubbery. I didn't realize until afterwards that it was supposed to have Red Sea crab on top like it says on the menu, they forgot it on mine. Don't think you should charge people for something they didn't get expensive dish too. I put a picture of mine versus what they advertise.
reviews.author: Natalie F.

reviews.text:
Hubs and I stopped in here for lunch. The Phoenician is a beautiful hotel with a great course. There is a parking garage with a beautiful walk to The Tavern. 

Every employee we encountered was super friendly and there wasn't a wait when we stopped in. We ordered the classic Tavern burger, shrimp stuffed rigatoni and Mac n cheese. The burger was cooked perfectly and was super juicy. The tots were crispy and seasoned well. The shrimp stuffed rigatoni was full of flavor with plenty of shrimp stuffed into the pasta and crab on top. The Mac n cheese was nothing special but the kids enjoyed the leftovers lol

Our server was so sweet and efficient. I don't remember his name but it started with an M. The place was clean, food tasted great only downside is prices are on the high side. Overall a nice spot for a meal.
reviews.author: Sara M.

reviews.text:
During my staycation at The Phoenician, the first stop was The Phoenician Tavern. 

I made it for happy hour and tried some of the menu items. The wings were not my favorite. The tavern rub had no flavor, but the wings were cooked crispy which I liked. The brussel sprouts were really tasty. There's a burger on the menu called The Cowboy. Instead of the burger patty I ordered it with a grilled chicken breast. My sister and I split it with an order of duck fat fries. That sandwich was sooooo good. I have to go back to try it as a burger. The Nashville Hot Bites were good also. I loved the diced pickle garnish.

Our waitress was nice and friendly but it took a while for her to come to the table when we first sat down and the table checks were very infrequent. 

The ambience was chill and the dining room had TVs around with sports playing which was nice. There are also nice views of the grounds since the tavern is on the 2nd floor.
reviews.author: Jaquay R.

reviews.text:
Our waiter came. He didn't speak very good English he took our order and it took more than 45 minutes to get our food. It was a busy Saturday night so it's understandable but the waiter never came back to the table never told us the food was on the way never, like he was scared to come to our table. There were A LOT of waiters. So we flagged down every employee we could find just to try to get some help. We repeatedly asked for the manager, asked multiple employees just to find out that the manager was hiding in the kitchen. Then when he did come out he told us to leave if we wanted to BECAUSE the food had another 10+ minutes to be done!!!!. Would have left this review on OpenTable but apparently they don't have us in the system. Not surprising considering the lack of competent management available. Paying for a room at this rate at a five-star resort is absurd if you can't even get a straight answer from your waiter and then a manager comes out and tells there is no help. AND told us to leave. Would give zero stars if possible
Horrible service, more horrible management.
Never coming back!!!!!
reviews.author: D G.

reviews.text:
Stayed out ate the Phoenician for the 4th of July holiday weekend this 2023 and went to the resorts Tavern to dine since I was in a casita down the way. 
Overall, the staff was very welcoming and polite.  As a typical resort restaurant the prices were higher then expected for just okay food.

Pros:
Location inside the resort 
Plenty of seating without reservations 
Staff very friendly and attentive 
Air conditioner was working very well

Cons:
Quality of food is not great.
Price of items is on the higher end
reviews.author: J C.

reviews.text:
Classic pub/tavern vibe. We were staying at the resort, so had to try it. Took forever to get our food. 
Some things were good, some okay, and some not good. 

Started with steamed mussels and half buffalo wings half dry spice rub wings. Mussels were actually great with the coconut lemongrass broth, my 9 year son said they were his favorite thing he ate on our trip. The wings were good, not great. Mushrooms were everyone's least favorite, don't get them. 

We all shared entrees, 
Chowda, pretty good, worth getting if you like chowder
The cowboy, we loved it, great flavor, thick bacon, the only downfall was the meat was over cooked. 
Patty melt, delicious! Those ale onions!! Loved it!
Waygu pastrami Ruben, this was our favorite sandwich, so so good, get it! The sweet potato fries are great!

Overall decent, but I wouldn't go out of your way to come here.
reviews.author: Dawn K.

reviews.text: If you eat here find Lynnae!!! Best customer experience...she did not hover but just had a sense of when I needed whatever I needed..more beverages, water refill, dessert. Then I went back with my husband for "adult milkshakes" and when she saw us she remembered who I was right away, introduced herself to my husband and ensured that the bartender knew how to make our drinks. She clearly knows her stuff and knows great hospitality!
reviews.author: Erin S.

reviews.text:
We went into the Tavern last night for my mother's birthday.  The food is outstanding and our server Lynne was fantastic and even on a busy night she made it feel comfortable and special. Our son is on the spectrum and it was very special the way she went out of the way to make him comfortable.
The piano players were fun however way too loud.  We could not even talk to each other. It made it so that we had to leave before we thought it would.
reviews.author: Kristy R.

reviews.text: First time I've been to the Tavern at The Phoenician Resort. Amazing views of the golf golf course, servers were very attentive, knowledgeable and friendly... Lynnae was so funny and just a joy to have wait on us! The hostess Bella was a complete joy. Best part of the entire experience  was the delicious food. We will definitely be coming back and recommending to all of our Colorado friends to visit!
reviews.author: Brett C.

reviews.text: Easily the worst dining service I've ever encountered. Host did seat us quickly, waitress took drink and app orders in a timely fashion. And that's all the positive there was. It was all downhill from there. Our drinks took 30+ minutes to arrive, apps came 45 minutes after ordering. Our main food dishes arrived 1 hour and 15 minutes after ordering.  Some food never arrived. The management was a joke. We were then held "hostage" as our bills took 30+ minutes after we requested them. Isn't this suppose to be part of a luxury resort??  It seems pretty basic....if you're understaffed, stop seating people. I would have happily ordered a pizza to our room. Instead I endured a 3 hour experience that should never have happened.
reviews.author: Abby T.

reviews.text:
Stopped in for a drink and snack after a round of golf. Head up the grand staircase to reach the tavern with lovely views of the Phoenician campus. 

We wanted something light and just stuck with the chips and salsa. All good. 

Service was excellent.
reviews.author: Lisa S.

reviews.text:
The Dueling Pianos (Fridays & Saturdays, 8-10pm) make this place special. It's a fun, casual, super friendly atmosphere. Do make a reservation to ensure that you get a table. The bar is first come first served; however, it was packed and a couple of people ended up having to stand. If you're staying at the Phoenician resort, note that The Tavern is a 5 min walk from the main hotel; however, they will take you in a golf cart if you ask.

I had the regular burger, but asked to switch the beef patty for a bison patty and they did it free of charge. It comes with a choice of regular or sweet fries or a salad. The sweet potato fries were probably the best I've had. The burger was decent too - juicy and messy :)  

Solid selection of beer, okay cocktails but definitely overpriced (not nearly special enough for what they are). 

The $25 burger is worth it if you come for Dueling Pianos and get a show with your dinner! Otherwise, i'd probably opt for one of the nicer restaurants on the property for the same price point.
reviews.author: Daria A.

reviews.text: The food and service was great. I was visiting the spa next door with my sisters and the spa menu was too bland for us lol. It was nice to get out of the spa and enjoy a table side lunch post service. The other restaurants were on the other side of the property so this place was very convenient as well.
reviews.author: Felle F.

reviews.text: Came here for lunch after our spa appointments. Got seated quickly and greated by our waitress. She gave good explanations of the dishes and drinks. Food came out and everything was tasty.  My sisters got cocktails that they really liked, I had a prickly pear Arnold Palmer which was really good. Overall it's what you'd expect from a tavern food setting, definitely good quality considering it's located at the Phoenician resort.
reviews.author: Kelly L.

reviews.text: Solid spot for a meal and the view. The staff are all Professional and Friendly. The salad I had was perfect. not overly dressed and served perfectly chilled. Nice option for a drink or 3 after a round of golf.
reviews.author: Manny G.

reviews.text: just had a luncheon here and it is the best hidden secret in scottsdale. . . . food. service and views are wonderful   the resort is gorgeous~!!!!!!!!!!!!!  try it~!!!!!
reviews.author: Mary Ann P.

reviews.text: The menu is somewhat limited, but everything on the menu they do extremely well. The service was outstanding, befitting a five star resort. We were entertaining guests from out of town, and they were very impressed! We will definitely return to the tavern.
reviews.author: Michael P.

reviews.text: The food was delicious and the service was great. There were some really delicious-sounding menu items that I wish I could have ordered if I was hungrier! I got the Classic Tavern Burger and asked for a bison patty rather than a beef patty. It was delicious as well as the sweet potato waffle fries. My friend ordered the yellowfin tuna sandwich with a side salad, which reportedly was not as good as my burger. For an appetizer, we ordered a special charred brussel sprout dish that was incredible - some tangy vinaigrette, parmesan cheese, and pomegranate seeds. Brussel sprouts are delicious when they're done right! The dueling pianos event was fun but it was pretty loud and made it difficult to continue my conversation with my friend. Overall, great restaurant!
reviews.author: Charis W.

reviews.text:
We came for Dueling Pianos (Fridays 8-10PM). The pianists were so fun and talented. It was a great time. 

I recommend coming early (like around 7) to be able to get dinner orders in before the kitchen closes.
reviews.author: Libby L.

reviews.text:
The is the second year in a row for our team stay-cation at the Phoenician.  Last year's group meal at the Tavern had extremely slow service but we thought we would give it another chance this year.  Even though we had reservations well in advance (24 people), we had absolutely horrible service.  It took 1 1/2 hours to get everyone their first round of drinks.  Several did not get their food until others were begging at the front desk for their bill.  Overall a complete disaster AND....  everyone who ordered straight well drinks, I.e. gin & tonic, were served and charged for top shelf (i.e. Hendricks).  A double vodka Redbull cost $44!  

I don't know how the food was... we were all too upset with the service and the insane prices to compare notes on the food.
reviews.author: Jackie W.

reviews.text:
Went last minute on a Friday night got there and the place was packed to our surprise and they had live entertainment and they were taking request on songs the whole atmosphere was great it was very fun we had a great time! 
I ended up ordering the chard chicken thigh which is new on the menu it was very good but it was very pricey for it to be just one chicken thigh and four roasted carrots only it was $40. 
Also please be aware that martinis are very pricey here  at $30 each. 

Our server was great that atmosphere was great we had a really good time with the live music.
reviews.author: Gerald J.

reviews.text:
Just meh. Everyone seems new and doesn't really know their own menu. My husband and I got a burger and chicken sandwich to split with sweet potato fries and tator tots.
We started with Moscow mules and they were great.
Good took over 45 mins for food to come out while others who arrived and ordered after us had their food first. Server was very nice but didn't really know what she was doing.
Food came and all was cold like it had been sitting there for a quite a while. Didn't care for the bun on the burger, it just fell apart and tasteless. Only thing that gave the chicken sandwich any taste was the pepper-jack cheese. 
We ate it minus sending back the sweet potato fries for a fresh batch and then they were delicious. 
They need to make some changes.
reviews.author: Ashley W.

reviews.text: Not much to say, the waitress was flighty, drinks over priced and light pour, salad was sub-par. Wasn't worth it after the playing golf in rare rain.
reviews.author: Myshell G.

reviews.text:
Located about the Gokf Club The Phoenician Tavern has some really good bar food. Pricy cocktails  and classic drinks with a good beer menu. Beautiful outdoor views most every table.  They do have a wine cellar list. If weather permits I recommend the patio overlooking the golf course. The interior is still very bright allowing the outdoors in during the day. I thought this was a place for the guys to hang for the day and have a couple afternoon drinks. It does make a great hang out after T time, but they do have a children's menu and families are welcome. 

The menu offers a few snacks, salads, sides, and crafted sandwiches.  They offer a hot skillet cookie with nuts and ice cream for dessert. 

They guys enjoyed the food. From my husband and his Classic Tavern Burger, to the Smoked BBQ Pork, and a Pastrami. Gluten free buns are available for extra upon request. Though when requesting them would only be for health reasons not to avoid allergies as none of their crafted sandwiches are noted gluten free. Just their chips, salsa and a salad. I am going off the paper menu they provide. I was not there to confirm or ask. Bar food is usually not that gluten friendly which is fine and expected. No complaints from the guys.
reviews.author: Jessica S.

reviews.text:
Most amazing service and food!!!
Loved the burrata, best ever!!!
And the pickled dills are to die for!!
Best lunch ever.
reviews.author: Jyotika M.

reviews.text:
This rating is for their Happy Hour which runs daily till 5pm!
We booked through Open Table, so keep that in mind to collect your points!
We asked our server for recommendations for appetizers and he suggested the kale and artichoke dip with bacon for $2. We got exactly that (even though it was not on the HH menu). The best artichoke dip I've ever had! Creamy at the bottom, a bit of char on the top and the saltiness of the bacon wrapped everything together. The chips for dipping was so good, when I ran out of the artichoke dip, I ended up munching on them with my ranch dressing!
We had the cheese curds from the HH menu, very good, but it couldn't top the dip we just had. We wrapped up with the burrata and pesto. Nice and refreshing- great way to wrap up our afternoon after playing 18 holes. Margaritas for $6 was not made with premix (or so I couldn't tell) lots of draft specials!
Definitely excellent place to pop by, especially after 18 holes at the Phoenician!
reviews.author: Julie C.

reviews.text:
If you are looking for a great meal, relaxed vibes by a golf course, and a beautiful property to walk around afterwards???? Then The Phoenician Tavern is just the place! 

The spicy fried pickles were nice and hot, right out of the fryer. The kale and artichoke dip was creamy and service on a hot skillet. 

As for the burgers and sandwiches they were cooked to perfection. The sweet potatoes fries and tatter tots were very crispy. The portions are rather large so I would recommend sharing or left overs! 

I can't wait to go back and try out more of their menu!
reviews.author: Cameo L.

reviews.text: This place is great our pool attendant Sulem was exceptional, my wife was looking for some seats at the pool and she had a bit of an altercation with a couple who said they were saving some chairs for their friends who have not been down here all day and were quite nasty with my wife and sulem saw this and located two great spots for us! Thanks again to Sulem for going above and beyond with her guest service
reviews.author: Noni T.

reviews.text: Great views but most importantly, great service.  Tabitha was our server and she went over and beyond doing her job.  She was professional, informative and a great worker.  Her attitude was amazing and she made our experience the best.
reviews.author: Julie S.

reviews.text: We had appetizers and drinks at the bar.  Very relaxing.  A great experience during covid.   Staff made sure to sanitize the bar area before we sat down and they were quick to sanitize when we left.  Helpful, professional and attentive.  We'll be back to try dinner in the future.
reviews.author: Lisa C.

reviews.text: VERY clean and great customer service! The fried pickles were definitely my favorite and happy hour margaritas were a hit. Got engaged a few hours prior and we received complimentary champagne!
reviews.author: Kassandra L.

reviews.text: Excellent food. Stayed at the Phoenician and this was one of few restaurants open. Came for dinner and breakfast dining in and all the food was delicious. Ordered burgers one day for lunch, take out and ate in the room, you wouldn't even know it was take out. The burgers were cooked to perfection, were still hot and all other ingredients were fresh and intact. Sides were also delicious. Would even come here while not staying at the hotel. Nothing fancy but a good old pub style restaurant with great quality food.
reviews.author: Michael S.

reviews.text: Excellent food and service. We were very impressed with the social distancing and cleaning guidelines. The food was flavorful and the kids meals were perfect.
reviews.author: Nadia S.

reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician for my 40th bday and decided to walk over for happy hour. Our bartender, Darren was fantastic and the experience that much better. His margaritas were one of the best I've ever had and after two, let's just say I was feeling GREAT! If you're ever on the property, make sure you stop by and ask for Darren!
reviews.author: Ta'keisha R.

reviews.text:
I'll start with...the resort is absolutely gorgeous and after a long day of driving - we were hungry! So,we cleaned up and came to the Tavern for dinner since everything else was closed. Got here and the gals were super friendly which is always great! The menu is typical bar/pub food and they had a pretty interesting drink menu so I was excited to get a cocktail. Let me just say, this place looks so much better than the food tastes. We ordered:

Nashville Hot Fried Chicken Bites - Not bad but there's very little flavor and it's mostly a mouth full of spicy fried powder

Fried Pickles - Ok but nothing to write home about. 

Smoked Tri Tip "French Dip" - It was like eating a brick of salt. The sodium was overwhelming with no real flavor. *Hard Pass*

Tavern Fries- Tastes like regular fries but less crispy and zero taste of parm or garlic.

Smoked Watermelon (Sombra Mezcal, Watermelon Puree, Jalapeno, Mint, lime juice, smoked salt) - Sounds good right? Well, I thought so when I ordered it and when it arrived it looked so pretty. I took my first and last sip. It has got to be the worst thing I have ever tasted. Imagine a race car doing a burn out on your tongue OR tasting a charred piece of rubber. I couldn't take one more sip so I basically threw my money away. Sadly, I mentioned to the server and she couldn't care less.

Barrel Aged Old Fashioned - OMG this was amazing! It has the perfect amount of sweetness and was delicious! I still think about this drink and wish I knew somewhere local that made them this exact way.

Overall, service was ok (could be due to COVID) and the food was sub par. We ordered take out from tons of other places during our stay and never went back to the Tavern.

Wish the other restaurants at the resort were open.
reviews.author: Christine V.

reviews.text:
The lamb chops were incredible, it was paired with a type of curry sauce. I wish they asked me how I'd like it grilled as it came out medium. The salmon was very average but came with a red chimichurri sauce which elevated it by a million times - I asked for extra. 

Super casual vibe, friendly service, full bar and awesome views overseeing the golf course.
reviews.author: Sieraaj A.

reviews.text:
A cool spot with the golf course view, on a beautiful day, it's a perfect spot to chill here, what a pretty view! 

They offer plenty of local craft beers, cocktails and wine too. Sport fans, this place got you covered! Plenty of TVs to watch your games! Happy hour, solid options of bar food but healthier and tastier!

Love the SMOKEHOUSES BURGER here, house blend prime beef & Neuskie's bacon, BBQ sauce, Cooper City bourbon onions, smoked gouda, yum! 

Hubby also enjoyed the Mac & Cheese too.

The SMOKED TRI-TIP "FRENCH DIP", horseradish cream, beer braised onions, hoagie roll was tasty! 

CASHEW CHICKEN SALAD roasted chicken, sun dried cranberries, grapes, water cress, mayo, toasted brioche bun was pretty solid!

Stayed at the Phoenician Resort, if you don't want to walk over at night or in the rain, the bellmen/valet guys can take you here by the golf cart. And they can pick you up too! 

A perfect spot for you to stop in after your golf session, or just to chill and watch some games or just to enjoy the beautiful view! 

Great service while we were here; another Dog friendly resort and restaurant. There was a beautiful blondes pony tail young lady served us, she was great! And the food is so reasonable here!
reviews.author: Manda Bear B.

reviews.text:
This is a newer restaurant for the Phoenician. It is right off the golf course.

Solid bar food. Burgers are fantastic. LOVE the spicy fried dill pickles. They have seasoned tater-tots!

When we golf at the Phoenician or do a stay-cation, this is a must.
reviews.author: Tracy D.

reviews.text: Terrible food + awful service = 1 star. I have no idea what has happened to this place as we used to love it when it was Relish. Just left there after one of the worst meals we have eaten in years which was prolonged by the worst service we have received in years. How can a restaurant fail to even make a decent burger??? The answer would be using poor quality ingredients and overcooking the patty to the point of inedibility. Then add some ice cold carmelized onions and a bready bun and voila, the worst burger known to mankind! Had we not had to pay for this meal, it would have been comical how long it took to get drinks. We had nearly finished our appetizer before our first round of drinks arrived (a glass of wine and a can of beer) 20 minutes after we had ordered them. It took another 20 minutes after ordering to get the second round of drinks and the server did not even bother to ask if anything was wrong with the food as she cleared away our plates that each contained half an uneaten burger and most of the plastic-tasting tater tots. It was a Sunday afternoon with a total of eight other customers in the place! I have no idea how this place is in business, but I can't imagine that they will be long. Please bring back the food and service of Relish!
reviews.author: Michelle G.

reviews.text:
We had a 5:45 reservation at J&G Steakhouse so the 4 of us arrived at 4pm knowing we could take in Happy Hour at The Tavern.  What a disappointment.............$5 wine was a Pinot Gris and a Malbec...........those were the wine choices for $5............what a laugh.  They should offer a REAL Happy Hour that gives customers a Choice.  My friend ordered Grey Goose up with olives ( no blue cheese olives available...........understood, it's a Sports Bar) but $20 for Vodka straight up is way Overpriced.
The wait staff was very personable and you could tell that she had to explain this Happy Hour situation to many customers.  We asked to speak to a manager.  I think it was Miguel who was very personable.  We
complimented our server for her performance but mentioned the Happy Hour displeasure of choices and $$$ for vodka.  
I felt it necessary to post a review.
reviews.author: Becki P.

reviews.text: Came here after the spa. It's by the golf club so expect lots of men at the bar after a round of golf. We ordered poutine fries which were not poutine fries and tasted meh. The fried calamari and shrimp was very delicious. I left a bag there and called that night. They told me they would leave it with security and I just needed to go to the lobby to pick it up. The next day I go to the lobby and they have nothing. They call the restaurant and they had it but failed to leave it with security like they said they would. I go to the restaurant to pick it up and they don't apologize for not keeping their word and making me go back and forth.
reviews.author: Jess K.

reviews.text: The entrance was a bit confusing. There is a side stairway but it leads to an unlocked door behind the dueling piano space. Luckily, a staff member was around to open it. We went to the front desk and were seated promptly but it took a while to get our drink order. Once we were approached by the waitress and got our order for drinks in, it took a while to get our drinks - a beer flight, a mule and an iced tea. The restaurant was moderately crowded but not to the point where - like that night - we did not see servers walking around, attending to their tables. We got the beer flight first, then the mule just before the appetizers were served and then the iced tea came after appetizers came. When we ordered, we got the restaurant week specials. The appetizers were amazing (kale-artichoke dip, Nashville fried chicken and pork belly poutine). The main course was ok. The Wagyu tri-tips was very gristly, chewy and wasn't edible. The macaroni the accompanied it was great. We ended up asking for a new order of tri-tips to be cooked medium well and that actually came out way better. I had asked for the Cowboy Burger sauce to be on the side and it came on it. It was cooked well done and was an okay tasting Burger. The fish and chips was actually delightful. It was a bit too breaded, but it was nonetheless good. The chocolate cake was ok. The server was very nice and you can tell she really wanted to help, but there were a lot of gaps in time where we didn't see any servers. I think the price is a bit over-charged for what you're receiving. I would say that this is good if I were staying onsite or if someone wanted to go there, but not a restaurant I would go out of my way to visit again.
reviews.author: Michelle M.

reviews.text:
The Phoenician Tavern is located by the golf course at the beautiful Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale. You turn right where you have to stop at the traffic booth, self park, second floor and you are there. They serve pub type food with more variety and more detail than from Relish (the restaurant that was previously in the spot). 

I tried the warm citrus salmon sandwich ($17.00). They gave me a very large amount of tender warm juicy salmon in a toasted dill bread sandwich. It was delicious and was made with a high quality heirloom tomato. My side salad was very fresh tasting and they de-seeded the cucumbers.

My husband tried the smoked wagu tri tip French Dip ($16.00). He received a packed sandwich with tender flavorful beef. He thought the Camelback IPA mustard on the sandwich was especially good!

I used my Scottsdale Preferred Card and got one meal free and didn't have any problems using the card.

My server was efficient and friendly.
reviews.author: Laura A.

reviews.text: Great atmosphere with views to enjoy of the surrounding area. Food and service top notch!!
reviews.author: Chris L.

reviews.text: The food was good, but the service was the worst I've ever experienced. We had to wait for everything, which was surprising since the area of the restaurant we were in had only 3 occupied tables and 3 servers. Waited to order, waited 10 minutes for water to be refilled, watched as a woman at the next table had to shout for service, watched an empty table sit with dirty dishes for 20 minutes. Our food came out at different times and some of the plates came out missing items. When I eventually got my salad, it had the wrong dressing. Then they brought us extra salads we didn't order. When we eventually were able to ask for the check (we all sat with empty plates for another 15 minutes), the server THEN asked if one member of our party would like a dessert. She said she would but would like to take it to go, and that we needed boxes. We got the check. No boxes, no dessert. They did remove some items from the charges since we had so many issues, yet still included their 20% gratuity.
reviews.author: Matthew W.

reviews.text: Amazing staff (Bartender Sara is great as well as another gentleman there) the food was to die for as well! Margaritas were on-point & flowin', as were the Mezcals. This may be my go-to now for HH or just about any occasion. See y'all soon
reviews.author: Blake S.

reviews.text: Afternoon lunch and drinks in this cool bar with a sports bar feel. Dueling pianos on Saturday evenings we will definitely return for.  Drinks were great. Food was a little underwhelming.
reviews.author: Kyle B.

reviews.text: Going with the "meh. I've experienced better" two stars here. Was expecting so much more from the Phoenician. The interior seemed like a Hilton coffee shop. The "dueling pianos" were what we came for - but were in no way entertaining or dueling - they were more like basic live music. Ones I've gone to in the past somehow play against each other and are really interactive. Acoustics were really harsh so made it hard to talk about the sounds (which were not interesting enough to focus on) Food was good - so that was a plus. Had Cobb salad and pretzel app. Both were great and I'd order again. Perfect place for a post-golfing drink or bite - but not a destination for fun.
reviews.author: Cori L.

reviews.text: Haven't been here for many years it has always been a  little pricey.  We had their chicken wings both buffalo  and barbeque.  The wings were on the small size 10 halves for a out 10 dollars . . We had the fish and chips . There were three large pieces . Very fresh but all the seasoning  was in the batter. Large portion  of fries. . We tried  the coleslaw  which I did not like it was dry and flavorless.  . The BLT was good. Staff was very friendly but the room was not set up for both of us to see the TV. We had the beignet  with chocolate  sauce.  It needed ice cream . They were  not crisp. And their were no sugar on them and they were very small. . The bill was 120 for lunch a little pricey.  We did enjoy the experience.  We did have leftovers.  I would  suggest  splitting your meal
reviews.author: Anthony K.

reviews.text:
The food at the Tavern has been amazing since it reopened! I've eaten there a few times so I can definitely recommend the Tavern Burger, Smokehouse Burger (bacon incorporated in the patty!), Player's Club, Warm Citrus Salmon, Sweet Potato Fries, and appetizers of Calamari and Chips/Salsa/Guac. Lots of options on the menu and the various dipping sauces are definite standouts in terms of flavor.

Also, at the time I went they confirmed the Tomato Bisque was vegan, and it was delicious! They are really accommodating with food allergies and I appreciate that they took the time to add some items to the menu that are allergen friendly (including gluten free bun options)!

I like the open-air atmosphere and patio seating when the weather is nice. The bartenders, servers, and runners are super friendly and even the chefs will come by to check on you. Also, best Moscow Mule in town!

You don't need to be staying at the Phoenician to eat there and there's a couple parking areas right next to it, so definitely stop by and check it out!
reviews.author: Kelsey A.

reviews.text: My husband and I went here for Sunday brunch and we ordered the burgers. They were really tasty, but my bun was really soggy unfortunately and I had to eat my burger patty with a fork! The drinks were really yummy. I think this place is a little overpriced for what they offer, but I would definitely try it again to see if my opinion changes. Service staff was friendly although a little inattentive. It took about five minutes once we were seated to be greeted.
reviews.author: Emily K.

reviews.text: Very delicious meal! Best shrimp and calamari that I've had in a very long time! Also the burgers were cooked to perfection! I would recommend to any Phoenician guest or Scottsdale visitor.
reviews.author: Danielle L.

reviews.text: I found the happy hour to be very reasonable for an expensive resort. the food and drinks with good the service was good
reviews.author: Damian L.

reviews.text: This place is amazing! Great food wonderful service and right on the golf course! The view is nice too, indoor and outdoor.
reviews.author: Kelli J.

reviews.text: Came for a birthday party for a couple of my friends and the views and happy hour were great. The service was on the slower end but honestly if you're here to mingle it's not that big of a deal. Everything on the menu was pretty pricey so I wouldn't come weekly but I would come back for an occasion. My friend and I discovered the Mac and cheese and oh my goodness was it good!!! Definitely recommend getting the Mac and cheese. It reminded me of Beechers cheese from Seattle. It was warm, cheesy with a nice crispy top! Loved it! Would go back for that.
reviews.author: Whittany H.

reviews.text:
I had been there a few times when it was Relish so was excited to see what the rebranded and renovated restaurant looked like.  There are some hits and misses.

First among the pluses, the new exposed patio concept is fantastic and really allows the property's scenery to deservedly be highlighted.  New counter height tables are a nice addition and the layout is less fragmented than before.  Service was another strong spot as we were greeted immediately and seated quickly.  Our server was fantastic and very pleasant to talk to.  Of the new menu, I would say that Tavern is much better value than Relish had been, especially with the cocktail list.  Whereas many of the Relish cocktails had been around $20 apiece, Tavern's options are much more reasonable.  They also offer a very well made marg as part of their happy hour deals.  

Sadly, the weak spot would be the standard burger itself.  While it was cooked as requested and had a good bun/condiments, the flavor of the beef patty itself was lacking the flavor or smokiness that the better burgers in town offer.  Similarly, the garlic and parmesan fries were cooked properly but a little bland.  On the flipside, the sweet potato fries were fantastic and the maple Thai chili dip they come with is original and highly recommended.  I do love spice and some heat, so I was missing the chipotle aioli they used to have since their other spreads, while having decent flavor, were missing the heat factor.  I also miss the salmon burger from the Relish menu although I did notice a salmon sandwich that's new so I'll need to try that.

Overall, the new Phoenician Tavern was a positive experience and I would come back here, however, it's not clocking in as a place I'd be craving to hit up.  I'd love to see them fine tune the stand burger and fries as well as offer a spicier aioli option but there is a good restaurant concept here.

Ambiance: ****/5
Food: ***/5
Service:  *****/5
reviews.author: Joshua R.

reviews.text:
My husband and I headed to the recently renovated Phoenician Tavern for a date night this weekend and had a great experience... The last time we were there was when it was Relish awhile back and it didn't make much of an impression then.  It's more memorable now and somewhere I am certain we'll return to for future date nights and/or with the kids in tow.

Sydnee was our server and she was super attentive and friendly.  Our drinks were solid and the food was more than satisfactory.  We were there on a Saturday night for the dueling pianos (they start at 8pm), and it was lively and entertaining.  Those guys are really talented!  We put in a few requests and they played them all in addition to some other favorite tunes across the board.  

If you're looking for a casual environment but a step up from a sports bar, a tasty burger or salad, and a fun atmosphere inside the Phoenician, look no further than the Tavern.  Bonus if you can get there for happy hour daily between 3pm and 6pm.  Enjoy!
reviews.author: Gabi M.

reviews.text: Enjoyed a delightful lunch here with friends on a recent visit for spring training baseball. Wonderful pub fare in a relaxed atmosphere with spectacular views of the grounds. "The tavern" was apparently part of the final phase of the resort's extensive remodeling and clearly no expense was spared. High end yet casual, I noted groups of friends, families and even golfers right off the greens sharing the comfortable atmosphere and terrific food. Our group chose from burgers to salads and each was wonderful in its own way. (Yes, it all looked so yummy we had to share a bit.) It takes a lot to impress this former New Englander when it comes to seafood and happy to report the lobster roll was outstanding (not to mention reasonably priced). Extensive craft cocktail and interesting wine list as well. Cannot say enough about the friendly and efficient staff, too. Best of all, you don't have to be staying at the resort to pop in. We'll be back!
reviews.author: Michele R.

reviews.text:
First time visitor and was very impressed with food and the ambiance!  Great modern look in the restaurant with a great view too!  I had the fish and chips which was amazing... that even came with malt-vinegar fries! 
 Yum!!

The staff was very friendly and accommodating with a gluten-free menu for one of the guests in my group who has gluten allergies.  Definitely a place I'd come back to!!
reviews.author: Michelle M.

reviews.text:
Can't say enough great things about the Tavern. Thoroughly enjoyed their fish n chips...perfect amount of batter and the malt vinegar fries are amazing!!
The classic burger was also delicious accompanied by sweet potato fries and yummy aioli sauce. 

Good atmosphere with large bar and indoor/outdoor seating with a nice view. 

They have one of my favorite beers on tap, Uncle Bears Amber Ale, a local favorite.

Staff was extremely nice...Rosa really stood out as very friendly, accommodating, and hard-working. 

Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Andrea D.

reviews.text: Visited The Tavern twice last week. Very impressed with the friendliness of the staff. Everyone had a smile on their face and were very welcoming. This impressed me. I had their fish and chips both visits, actually went back the second time specifically for it!  My sister and I have long been searching for a great Friday fish fry place, like the kind we are used to back in Chicago. We found it here. Best fish fry we have found in the Phoenix area yet. Great drinks too. Gabe at the bar was awesome! We will definitely be back very soon! Thank you!
reviews.author: Lauren D.

reviews.text: Brand-new restaurant with delicious food, cool modern western ambience, wonderful service! We dined two nights ago with longtime friends/family, a reunion dinner! I ordered the Black Bean Veggie Burger - very tasty. The staff was so accommodating, and thank you for outstanding service Sara and Gabe! An excellent choice :)
reviews.author: Ronald A.

reviews.text: We arrived and the restaurant was relatively empty around noon. We ordered one hamburger and one tomatoe soup. It took over and hour to get our mediocre food ( the soup was disgusting). Our waitress Amanda told us the general manager was here so the kitchen stopped what they were doing to make their food first - a great representation of what's important here - not the guest. Meanwhile about ten tables that got here after us ordered, we're served, and finished eating before we saw any food. We finally had to ask where our food was. A disappointing start to a stay at what's supposedly a luxury hotel.
reviews.author: Tilly R.

reviews.text: Came in for the grand opening with my boyfriend and my family. Of course it was busy so we made reservations. Arrived about 5 mins early, and had to wait, which is fine I understand we were early. When we were seated, we were placed in the middle of the back room, very nice table. Not sure where the miscommunication was but we were sitting waiting for a server for 20 mins. I am not kidding it was 20 mins. I believe there was some sort of manager walking around sampling out beers. Well I asked him if he could send a server over and he said "of course." Waited some more and no one came by. So I walked over to the bar where 3 managers stood and told them the situation , one quickly apologized and walked over to take our order. We ordered drinks, green chili wings, chips and salsa, and tater tots. Finally, our server Austin came by. He was great!!! He was very apologetic and told us that he was actually pulled from another restaurant to come help. He was very attentive and personable, and I was impressed. We got our food and the quality was sub par. The wings were stone cold. The chips were ok and tater tots were fine. Then after we have all finished the appetizers our FIRST ROUND of drinks finally came. At this point I was so embarrassed to have brought my guests to this restaurant. What I don't understand is, there was a public Facebook event set up for the grand opening, how did management not know it was going to be this busy. Hope everyone else has better luck. I'll probably go back when they have a better handle on things.
reviews.author: Raquel C.
